### Resources
- [Current specs](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/blob/main/spec/eof.md)
    - [EIP-7692: EVM Object Format (EOFv1) Meta](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7692)
    - EIPs Included <details>
[EIP-3540](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3540): EOF - EVM Object Format v1
[EIP-3670](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3670): EOF - Code Validation
[EIP-4200](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4200): EOF - Static relative jumps
[EIP-4750](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4750): EOF - Functions
[EIP-5450](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5450): EOF - Stack Validation
[EIP-6206](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6206): EOF - JUMPF and non-returning functions
[EIP-7480](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7480): EOF - Data section access instructions
[EIP-663](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-663): SWAPN, DUPN and EXCHANGE instructions
[EIP-7069](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7069): Revamped CALL instructions
[EIP-7620](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7620): EOF Contract Creation
[EIP-7698](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7698): EOF - Creation transaction </details>
- [EOF Meeting Playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJqWcTqh_zKHu7Z91YVYWy_PSmOc_66-F) 
- EOF explainers on [PEEPanEIP](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4cwHXAawZxqOHV_F40AJbzcl8b6tG8xw) <details>
[EVM Object Format (EOF) with Danno Ferrin](https://youtu.be/rlZwPuF149U)
[EVM Object Format (EIP-3540 & EIP-3670) with Andrei Maiboroda, Axic & Pawel](https://youtu.be/GMeRA-xPp-E) </details>
- [EOF Testing Coverage Tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/main/tests/prague/eip7692_eof_v1/tracker.md)
- [Solidity + EOF POC summary](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/solidity_eof_poc)
- Matrix on [evmobjectformat.org](https://evmobjectformat.org/)

## Agenda
- Client updates
- Compiler updates
- Spec updates
  - Revisit EXT*CALL returncodes - [onReceived must be able to distinguish successful calls](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/evm-object-format-eof/5727/97) Ref: [here](https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/117.)
  - Improve runtime stack overflow check for CALLF/JUMPF by https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/134.
  - Finalize the change to disallow referencing the same container by EOFCREATE and RETURNCONTRACT https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/135
  - (evmone implementation https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/commit/3e6cf42eb17246cd2692cbc42a569136b6b06f3a)
- Testing updates 
- Other items
  - Discuss evmone-t8n execution when the beacon root contract (EIP-4788) is not in the pre.

Please add other agenda items or links to discuss.

### Next call on July 10th, 2024
